data.title: Greenville
data.about:
Greenville at Emaar South is an exciting new residential project by Emaar Properties, offering 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses designed with contemporary architecture and surrounded by lush greenery. This vibrant community blends leisure, convenience, and luxury, creating the perfect environment for families and individuals. With premium amenities like pools, gyms, and children’s play areas, Greenville promotes an active, serene, and sustainable lifestyle.

Located in Emaar South, Greenville benefits from proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport and easy access to key destinations in Dubai and Abu Dhabi. This thoughtfully planned community provides a peaceful retreat from urban life while ensuring residents remain connected to the region’s bustling hubs. Greenville at Emaar South is the perfect blend of luxury, sustainability, and tranquility, making it an ideal place to call home.

characteristics_module.title: Elegant Townhouses and a Serene Lifestyle at Greenville, Emaar South
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Located in Emaar South, offering easy access to Al Maktoum International Airport and major hubs in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
  • Lush Green Surroundings: Experience tranquil living amidst expansive greenery, parks, and scenic landscapes.
  • Premium Amenities: Enjoy swimming pools, gyms, children’s play areas, and community parks for a vibrant lifestyle.
  • Active and Healthy Living: Walking trails, jogging paths, and sports facilities promote an active lifestyle.
  • Family-Friendly Community: Safe and secure environment with 24/7 security, perfect for families.
  • Sustainable Living: Designed to foster an eco-friendly lifestyle, with green spaces and sustainable development principles.
  • Spacious 3 & 4-Bedroom Townhouses: Flexible property options to suit diverse lifestyle needs.

location_tile.title: Greenville at Emaar South – Where Modern Living Meets Nature
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Strategically situated in Dubai South,  Greenville by Emaar Properties at Emaar South Dubai offers seamless connectivity to key landmarks. The community's location offers significant investment potential, with the future expansion of Dubai South and its proximity to Expo City Dubai, which is set to become a major hub for commerce and tourism. Greenville’s seamless access to airports, business parks, and leisure attractions ensures residents enjoy both convenience and lifestyle, making it a prime destination for families, professionals, and investors alike.

  • 7 Minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 10 Minutes to Expo City Dubai
  • 20 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 30 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
